comparison.objective: Bimanually lifts a long rod over glasses and places it on two rests; candidate fractures and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated long-object transport and obstacle clearance differ from asymmetric mandrel stabilization/hammering and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Rod must rest across supports without disturbing glasses; candidate requires four contained fractures with no coil or shell damage and stable tool release.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual and damage-sensitive, but they test different coordination and contact-mechanics abilities.
